$comment: Gzip size budgets for the built web assets, checked by `pnpm perf:check` after `pnpm build`. Set from the template's measured build rounded up: the initial JavaScript (every visit: the entry index.html loads and the chunks it preloads, whatever the bundler names them) 108.1 kB, the error tracking chunk (fetched only when WEB_SENTRY_DSN is set) 31 kB, the Web Vitals chunks (fetched after the first render, the library only for sampled page loads) 4.2 kB, the account and admin pages (password recovery and change, sign-up and its confirmation, change of email and its undo, invitations and their acceptance, fetched when opened, with the helpers only they use) 12.2 kB, the focus and error handling of their forms included, the second factor's step (fetched while the password is checked: every sign-in passes it, docs/adr/0012) 2.4 kB, CSS 0.7 kB. The admin pages of Audit Hub (docs/adr/0014), each a lazy route, with the signed-in frame they load after sign-in and the helpers they share, 34.5 kB measured, budgeted at that plus 10%; their SVG charts 1.5 kB. The total keeps a new lazy chunk from hiding outside the named ones; it grew from 145 to 157 kB with the account and admin pages, to 160 kB with the second factor's step, and by exactly the two admin-page budgets to 200 kB. When public sign-up was closed, invitations got their applications and the event tables were redesigned (2026-10-19, docs/adr/0014), the account and admin pages measured 13.7 kB (the invitation's applications, sign-up's closed notice) and are budgeted at 15 kB; the admin pages of Audit Hub measured 42.1 kB with the event detail drawer and the view it shares with the event's page (both fetched when a row's details are opened), the overview's summary and quick response actions and the highlighted JSON viewer, budgeted at that plus 10%, 46 kB; the total grew by exactly those two raises, to 210 kB. With the alerts' detail drawer and the view it shares with the alert's page (same day), the admin pages of Audit Hub measured 44.6 kB and the total 207 kB, both within. Each project sets its own from its performance targets (docs/testing.md#performance-budget).
